config.sqlTemplate: SELECT sum(delta) AS accepted FROM (SELECT MetricName, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_%' GROUP BY MetricName)

SELECT sum(delta) AS failed FROM (SELECT MetricName, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND (MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_refused_%' OR MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_failed_%') GROUP BY MetricName)

SELECT sum(delta) AS exported FROM (SELECT MetricName, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_exporter_sent_%' GROUP BY MetricName)

SELECT round(100 * maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'otelcol_exporter_queue_size') / greatest(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity'), 1), 1) AS queue_pct FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('otelcol_exporter_queue_size', 'otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity')

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS series, max(Value) - min(Value) AS accepted FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans', 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records', 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('otelcol_exporter_queue_size', 'otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity', 'otelcol_exporter_in_flight_requests') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS series, max(Value) - min(Value) AS failed FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND (MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_refused_%' OR MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_failed_%') GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(max(Value) / 1024 / 1024, 1) AS rss_mb FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'otelcol_process_memory_rss' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(100 * (max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s, 2) AS cpu_pct FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'otelcol_process_cpu_seconds' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT Attributes['job'] AS job, maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'up') AS up, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'scrape_duration_seconds'), 3) AS scrape_seconds, max(TimeUnix) AS last_scrape FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('up', 'scrape_duration_seconds') GROUP BY job ORDER BY job
